title: pm-dispatch(batch): a slot is a RUNNING subagent or card thread — PRs awaiting approval, the queue, CI or a ruling occupy none; the round report counts running and un-landed separately; a soft ceiling on accepted Tier H PRs awaiting a human
body:
Filing gate ③ (maintainer-directed). Filed by the `domain:skills#2` seat (`os-justin`, `session_01QSeKYmhU5KEj1nukYhp1Tg`, seat post #19287) from the maintainer's questions in that session on 2026-10-28. ⛔ Not a claim; `domain:*` pre-labelled because every path is in the skills tree — triage grades.

## The maintainer's words (verbatim, in order)

1. 「给车道交代的并发，如果已经开了pr或者等审核的时候，应该占用并发额度吗」
2. On the seat's reading that the protocol already says no: 「同意维持「不占并发」，但是 车道执行的时候经常没有按照这个标准」
3. 「skills 需要改进吗」
4. On the seat's four-item proposal (items 1–3 the text fix, item 4 a soft ceiling): 「立卡，带第 4 项」

## Business reason

`batch` exists to bound what burns at once (container CPU and the verify lock, tokens, the seat's review attention). A PR waiting for an approver, the merge queue or CI burns none of that, and the protocol already says so in three places — but seats read 「在飞」 as 「在飞的卡」 (`pm:dispatched` count) and stop dispatching with four PRs merely waiting for a human. The text leaves that reading open; this card closes it, adds a reading that makes the mix-up visible in every round report, and adds the one cap the batch cannot express: how many accepted Tier H PRs may wait on a human before the seat stops producing more of them.

## Reader who acts

The `domain:skills` seat; Tier S (`.claude/**`), `SKILL.md` ⇒ ceiling-tier build + contract review. Serial on `SKILL.md` behind PR #27082 (#26997, awaiting the maintainer's landing) and coordinated with #27047 (the p0 card also rewrites the `batch` row's p0 clause — whichever lands second merges `origin/main` and keeps both meanings).

## What lands (one PR; every file is at its line ceiling — 319 / 188 / 245 / 96, headroom 0 — so every edit is IN PLACE, no new line, no re-wrap as currency)

1. **`SKILL.md` L59, the `batch:<n>` row** — today 「席位同时在飞的子代理总上限,按 `Agent` 调用、`create_session` 与卡线程计:dev、复核、普查皆计,⛔ 只读不豁免」. Rewrite as a countable definition: a slot is a subagent or card thread RUNNING now; the report landing releases it; four waiting states occupy no slot — awaiting a human approval, in the merge queue, awaiting CI, awaiting a maintainer ruling; `⛔ 只读不豁免` stays. The word 「在飞」 leaves this row (it names cards elsewhere).
2. **`references/dispatch-runbook.md` L137** — today 「卡线程交回或其 PR 合入,席位当即告知 coordinator 释放槽位」. Drop the 「或」: hand-back releases the slot at once; the thread stays open through review to take a FAIL and occupies none; a REWORK patch round occupies one again. **`references/execution-duties.md` L21** 「等待不填槽」 → 「等待(四态见 SKILL.md `batch` 行)不填槽」, so there is one definition.
3. **`references/seat-lifecycle.md` L70 (轮次报告)** — the report carries one fixed line with two numbers: 「在跑 N / batch · 待落地 PR M」. The two can never legitimately be the same number; a seat that writes them cannot confuse them.
4. **Soft ceiling (the maintainer's item 4)** — one line in `execution-duties.md` 〈候选与批次〉: when the seat's accepted Tier H PRs awaiting a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` approval number more than 5, the seat dispatches no new Tier H card (Tier S and non-governed cards continue) and names the backlog in the round report. A SOFT rule: no gate, no script, no label (「新增门禁默认否」); the round-report line of item 3 is its only reader. Re-measure after two weeks of round reports and keep, move or drop the number.

## Premises (each with its re-check)

- P1 — the three texts, as quoted, on `origin/main`: `grep -n 'batch:<n>' .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` (L59); `grep -n '等待不填槽' .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md` (L21); `grep -n '释放槽位' .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md` (L137); `grep -n '报告加升级项' .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md` (L70). Positive control: the same greps for `pm:dispatched` hit every file.
- P2 — the observed mis-reading: this seat's own shift on 2026-10-28 counted 「在飞 3/3」 while one subagent ran and four PRs waited (seat post #19287 r69 and the round report); the maintainer's word 2 names it as recurrent across lanes.
- P3 — the ceilings: `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` prints `SKILL.md is 319 lines (ceiling 319; headroom 0)`, `execution-duties.md 188 / 188`, `dispatch-runbook.md 245 / 245`, `seat-lifecycle.md 96 / 96`.

## Acceptance

- A seat reading `SKILL.md` alone can count its slots from the row: running subagents/threads only, the four waiting states named as non-occupying.
- `dispatch-runbook.md` has no 「或」 between hand-back and merge; `execution-duties.md` points at the one definition and carries the soft ceiling (5) as a sentence, not a check.
- The round-report template in `seat-lifecycle.md` carries the two-number line.
- `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:pm-governed-prose`, `check:skill-frame-sync` green; line counts unchanged.
- `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none` · Size S · Tier S.

Dedupe (REST list, `labels=domain:skills`, open 27 + closed 400, title/body grep `batch|并发|concurren|WIP|占槽|填槽|slot`): open → #27047 only (the p0 card: p0 exempt from `batch`, a different clause of the same row — serial, not duplicate); closed → #20154 (re-seated PM starts at batch 3 — the default, not the definition), #20957 (retired the one-`tooling`-slot rule). **New.**
